name: @cobuntu/course-management-ui
description: Shared course (learning) authoring UI + API layer for Cobuntu apps. Mirrors @cobuntu/product-management-ui and @cobuntu/event-management-ui.
//: Shared libs are peerDependencies, not deps: this package is consumed as SOURCE via transpilePackages, and both host apps already ship these. Declaring them as deps pins ranges that don't match the apps' installed majors (framer-motion 12, @dnd-kit/modifiers 9, ...) and npm then nests a second copy into the bundle. Peers let each app provide its single copy.
